statement: In pinned Linux hid-wiimote, Gen20 (-TR) includes the built-in MotionPlus module, while MotionPlus discovery reads the six-byte ID at A600FA and accepts it based on the last byte being 0x05. The same kernel code writes 0x04 (standalone), 0x05 (Nunchuk pass-through), or 0x07 (Classic-style pass-through) to A600FE according to the extension. These are host initialization requirements and do not prove a TR-only physical identifier, register timing, or different calibration from external MotionPlus.

applicability.revision: RVL-CNT-01-TR host behavior versus external MotionPlus
applicability.scope: Pinned Linux hid-wiimote-core.c lines 469-530, 594-605, 1100-1129; complements wii-tr-consumer-revision and C5 MotionPlus packing evidence without promoting device-side status.
